publication_policy: never publish or overwrite course slides without explicit user approval

checks.rule: Matte navy, restrained orange/cyan/violet semantics; slim edges and flat readable type
Mechanism, example and meaningful consequences are visually traceable
Every decision, label, arrow, security boundary and numeric/code example verified
Full-resolution and normal-viewport inspection; no tiny or compressed copy
Every required source concept accounted for without omission or unsupported expansion

layout_policy: content-driven; never mechanical alternation or repeated cards
qa_procedure: check technical data with deterministic tools
only then propose for user approval
